title: Fix CAD Mesh and Brep Edge Display
description: CAD meshes display shredded with holes because fixture wires are imported with wrong edge orientation (54/57 forest wires). Lines are unclean because B-rep edge samples are dropped and World3d falls back to EdgesGeometry on bad mesh. Fix wire_points chaining, carry edge_positions through mesh_data_from_mesh_transfer, prefer B-rep edges over EdgesGeometry in World3d.
summary: Fixed energy/structure surfaces rendering flat on the floor. Root cause: fixture wires include zero-length degenerate closing edges; face tessellation failed with "degenerate line: start == end", so object_mesh_data fell back to typology box at z≈0. Skip degenerate wire edges when chaining, dedupe consecutive wire points before polyline import, and skip zero-length edges in kernel boundary sampling. Added height regression tests for energy baseplate and structure slab (z≈3).
